note: v492: Statements tidy-up. With the Statements section switched off, the Expenses tab no longer keeps an "Account" filter that quietly narrows the list by something nothing else in the app still shows. The audit grid stays on the year you're browsing instead of jumping back to this year when a background check finishes. And launching without a connection no longer hides the "Bank account" field on every form for the rest of the session.
